name: open_screen
description: Take the customer to a screen in the app: home, chat, cards, calls (their booked callbacks), memory (what you remember about them) or profile. Use it instead of describing where to tap.

name: open_item
description: Open one of the customer's cards so they can see its limit and last use. Name the card as it appears on the Cards screen.

item.description: The card's name or its last four digits, e.g. "Travel credit card ···· 7730" or "7730".

name: freeze_card
description: Freeze one of the customer's cards so it cannot be used — when they report it lost or stolen, or ask for it to be frozen. Confirm which card first.

item.description: The card's name or its last four digits, e.g. "Travel credit card ···· 7730" or "7730".

name: unfreeze_card
description: Unfreeze a card the customer froze earlier, only when they ask for it. Confirm which card first.

item.description: The card's name or its last four digits, e.g. "Travel credit card ···· 7730" or "7730".
